lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters following a longitudinal distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with primary blobs, forming a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the pectoral fin attachment.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent longitudinal ridge on the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp luminance gradient with a high-intensity dorsal highlight and a low-intensity ventral shadow.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch and truncation at the apex of the first dorsal fin, indicating healed mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, high-luminance elongated shapes positioned ventrally beneath the pectoral fin and abdominal region.
